# Python Tutor

> > A visual debugger and AI-powered tutor for learning programming across Python, JavaScript, C, C++, and Java with step-by-step code execution visualization.

Python Tutor is an interactive online compiler and code visualizer designed to help students understand program execution through visual representation of stack, heap, and variable states. It combines traditional step-by-step debugging with AI tutoring capabilities, making it a valuable tool for computer science education at universities worldwide including MIT, Harvard, Princeton, UC Berkeley, and Tsinghua.

## Key Topics

## Core Tools

- [Python Tutor - Python Online Compiler with Visual AI Help](https://pythontutor.com/index.html): Homepage introducing Python Tutor: visual debugger and AI tutor for 5 languages
- [Python Tutor code visualizer: Visualize code in Python, JavaScript, C, C++, and Java](https://pythontutor.com/visualize.html): Main product interface for step-by-step code visualization and AI tutoring
